topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I opened the admissions website to check for updates, and there it was—an essay, mine, displayed as an example for prospective students. It was strange, encountering my thoughts and words in such a public setting, unanticipated. The essay, now a specimen, felt like a letter sent from a past version of myself. I wasn’t sure if it was meant for this kind of exposure, but there it was, contributing to the guidance of others. I took a moment to read through it, appreciating the effort and the bits of my journey that had been captured. Perhaps, in its new role, it could inspire someone, much like how I found guidance in the stories of others when I was preparing my application.
